findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 風險因子僅以一般性語言提及可能面臨含反壟斷在內的訴訟、調查與監管程序；未點名任何具體反壟斷調查或拆分命令。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We are, from time to time, subject to claims, lawsuits, investigations, and regulatory or administrative proceedings across the jurisdictions where we operate. These matters may involve commercial disputes, regulatory compliance, intellectual property, antitrust, product liability, employment and labor, privacy and data protection, securities laws, governance, and tax.

note: 兩次搜尋未見 DOJ/FTC/EU 對 Flex 的反壟斷調查，也未見 EMS 產業特定新規報導；搜尋結果多為無關公司。此為查無來源，不等於確認無調查。第三次搜尋未使用。
